facts.text: The hotel is in Alberta's Banff National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
facts.excerpt: Located in Alberta's Banff National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site

facts.text: The property began in 1890 as a small log cabin opened by Canadian Pacific Railway president William Van Horne for tourists arriving by train.
facts.excerpt: Its story began back in 1890 when William Van Horne, the president of the Canadian Pacific Railway, opened a small log cabin for tourists arriving by train to stay in.

facts.text: After a fire in 1924 destroyed much of the original cabin, it was rebuilt with a concrete structure and reopened as a large chateau-inspired hotel.
facts.excerpt: After a fire in 1924 destroyed much of the original cabin, it was rebuilt with a concrete structure and reopened as a large chateau-inspired hotel.

facts.text: BASIN Glacial Waters is a self-guided thermal experience at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: BASIN Glacial Waters is a self-guided thermal experience rooted in the power of contrast and the purity of nature.

facts.text: BASIN Glacial Waters has cold plunges, steam rooms and indoor-outdoor thermal pools.
facts.excerpt: From cold plunges and steam rooms to indoor-outdoor thermal pools

facts.text: BASIN Glacial Waters is an adults-only facility.
facts.excerpt: The adults-only facility is focused on thermotherapy

facts.text: Louiza is a Mediterranean-inspired restaurant at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: breakfast at Louiza, a casual and cool Mediterranean-inspired restaurant that is open daily

facts.text: The Fairview's dinner menu includes butcher's cuts, with locally sourced bison filet and elk striploin.
facts.excerpt: Make sure to try one of the butcher’s cuts, with locally sourced bison filet and elk striploin on offer.

facts.text: Afternoon Tea is served at Fairview Restaurant.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in the elegance of Afternoon Tea at Fairview Restaurant.

facts.text: The Alpine Social serves comfort food and craft beers.
facts.excerpt: stop by the Alpine Social for good ole fashion comfort food and craft beers.

facts.text: Lakeview guest rooms have views of Lake Louise and Victoria Glacier.
facts.excerpt: Guest Room featuring Spectacular Views of Lake Louise and Victoria Glacier

facts.text: Fairmont Gold guests have a private concierge, an exclusive lounge and complimentary breakfast.
facts.excerpt: Offering exclusive services and amenities, enjoy the convenience of your private concierge, exclusive cozy lounge and complimentary breakfast.

facts.text: In summer, guests can canoe on Lake Louise.
facts.excerpt: in the summertime, canoe peacefully through Lake Louise

facts.text: In cold weather the lake freezes over and becomes an ice-skating rink.
facts.excerpt: When the temperature drops, the lake freezes over and becomes an ice-skating rink

facts.text: The hotel has programming for kids.
facts.excerpt: We have designed specific programming that is active, enjoyable, and educational for kids through exclusive activities.

facts.text: Parking at the hotel is available for an additional fee.
facts.excerpt: Parking available for an additional fee

facts.text: The hotel charges a Resort Experience Fee per room per night in addition to the room rate.
facts.excerpt: there is an additional $45+tax CAD per room per night daily fee

facts.text: The on-site spa offers massage, body, face and nail salon services.
facts.excerpt: offers signature treatments including massage, body, face, and nail salon services
